capabilities: Mirror selected folders, notes and referenced attachments to a Cloudflare R2 bucket via a Worker
Expose an MCP server with search, read, recent-notes and attachment tools for AI clients
Synchronize on startup, file change, schedule or manual trigger with optional two-way sync and conflict copies
Authorize AI clients with read-only OAuth tokens while keeping writes on the local device via obsidian:// URIs
Transfer connection settings to mobile devices through an encrypted obsidian:// link
disambiguation: Not an embedded AI chat plugin; it mirrors notes to a remote store and exposes them over MCP for external AI clients instead of adding a chat box to Obsidian.
extras: Deployment is self-hosted: the user must create and deploy the Cloudflare Worker, R2 bucket and OAuth KV namespace themselves (a Windows setup wizard helps). The README includes a detailed cost breakdown for Cloudflare Workers, R2 and KV free and paid tiers, and notes that two-way sync is off by default and uses last-modified-time reconciliation, not paragraph merging.
intentEvidence: So this is not another plugin that simply puts an AI chat box inside Obsidian.
motivation: The author wanted notes and AI to stay independent so one can switch AI clients and devices freely, and already had an encrypted primary sync system but wanted a separate, deliberately unencrypted mirror for AI.
problem: AI plugins typically run a local chat or agent in Obsidian, so the AI cannot reach the vault from the web, another device, or after the computer is off.

relations.evidence: You need a Cloudflare account, Node.js/npm, and this project's source code.

requires.name: Cloudflare Workers Paid / R2 beyond free tier

summary: Self-hosted Cloudflare bridge that mirrors selected vault notes and attachments to R2 and serves them read-only to any MCP-compatible AI client.
